features.value: Shareholder register, shareholder management, certificates and dividends

texts: Sade has been part of the cultural life of San Sebastián for almost a century, with historic cinemas and theatres such as the Príncipe and the Trueba. Today it also runs hotels.
A company with so much history has many shareholders and several companies to keep up to date.
